title: Linear Regression
summary: Weighted sums, mean squared error, gradients, normal equations and feature scaling.
objectives: Explain why feature scaling speeds up training
socratic_prompts: What does a negative R squared tell you about a model?
How does an outlier affect a squared loss?

examples.title: Fit with NumPy
examples.code:
import numpy as np
X = np.c_[np.ones(4), [0, 1, 2, 3]]
y = np.array([1, 3, 5, 7])
print(np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0])  # [1, 2]
